dct_title_s: City of Minneapolis present and proposed playground facillities, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of the actual and proposed playground facilities in park in Minneapolis, Minnesota in 1914. The map is found in the Thirty-second Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 114.
